title: Sync is off by default: a reactor has no sync manager unless withChannelScheme or withSync is called
content:
A freshly built reactor does not sync. The sync subsystem in `@powerhousedao/reactor` is opt-in, and there are exactly two ways to opt in on the `ReactorBuilder`: `withChannelScheme(scheme)` or `withSync(syncBuilder)`. Call neither and `module.syncModule` is `undefined` — the reactor stores and reduces operations locally and never contacts a remote.

`withChannelScheme` is the shortcut. It constructs the channel factory and a `SyncBuilder` for you and starts the sync manager during `build()`:

```typescript
const module = await new ReactorBuilder()
  .withDocumentModelSources([/* ... */])
  .withChannelScheme(ChannelScheme.CONNECT)
  .buildModule();

const sync = module.syncModule?.syncManager; // ISyncManager | undefined
```

`withSync` is the full-control path: you hand over a pre-configured `SyncBuilder` when you need a custom channel factory, custom storages, or different limits. On this path the reactor builder still calls `syncManager.startup()` for you.

The gotcha is what happens when you call both. There is no error and no warning: **only the scheme path runs, and your custom `SyncBuilder` is discarded.** The scheme path always constructs a fresh `SyncBuilder` around the scheme's own factory, so any `withChannelFactory`, `withMaxInboxBatchSize`, or storage override you configured is silently thrown away. Use one or the other, never both.

A second, related trap: `SyncBuilder.build()` and `buildModule()` do *not* call `startup()`. That call is only made for you when the builder is routed through `ReactorBuilder`. If you construct a `SyncBuilder` directly, you must call `syncManager.startup()` yourself before adding remotes, or `add` will operate on a manager that was never started.

Note also that `withJwtHandler` only flows through the `CONNECT` factory; on the `SWITCHBOARD` path it is accepted and ignored.

_Source: apps/academy/docs/academy/04-Reference/01-Reactor/04-Synchronization.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
description: module.syncModule is undefined unless one of the two is called on ReactorBuilder. Setting both silently discards the custom SyncBuilder.
